affected_component: Runnable workspace dependency closure, launcher, preflight and replay
invariant: A runnable offline workspace that imports third-party Python dependencies must execute from the artifact's frozen dependency bytes, not from the verifier or developer environment. Core must own the launcher, exact lock, wheel closure and inventory; expected and actual workspaces must receive identical runtime sealing; smoke must run the delivered launcher under the offline sandbox; and a runtime-owned path collision must fail closed.
